arguments.recommended_next_step: After deleting malformed rows, check the failed-jobs backlog and proceed with the export of the failed_jobs table for the postmortem.
arguments.summary: The database CPU usage is high on pgbouncer, which listens on port 8081. Disk fullness issues are suspected due to Postgres refusing connections when the disk is full. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing all week. Investigate and export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem. A total of 47 malformed rows have been deleted from the failed_jobs table.
